word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Brainstorm Community Signals

conceptHeader.description: An endorsement or veto signal issued by a user for a target pubkey within the context of a specific Brainstorm Community. Mirror relays consume these signals via the GR Community scoring system to compute community membership. SKELETON — schema details may evolve before v1.1.0 is activated. See feat/communities/PLAN.md §3.
